verdict.rationale: Convex documents a public HTTP API that exposes deployment functions as callable endpoints, a full-featured CLI for scripting deployments, and an official MCP server specifically for AI agents to interact with the deployment — together giving an AI-native user multiple documented, programmatic ways to drive the product. Missing for 10: a formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probes found only 404s) and independent hands-on corroboration of third-party API usage.
